title: finding(plugin-view): three more `Record<ViewType, …>` totals carry a `page:` row that goes TS2353 on the retired spec — same class as objectui#9880, and ⛔ not the same repair
body:
Three more totals over the WHOLE `ViewType` carry a `page:` row that becomes an **excess property** (TS2353) once objectstack's retirement of the list-view kind `page` reaches this repo. Same defect class as objectui#9880, different package, and ⛔ **not** the same repair.

Seat-verified at source on `origin/main` **00c4df509** — printed, ⛔ not counted:

```
packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx:64   const DEFAULT_VIEW_LABELS: Record<ViewType, string> = {      … :76   page: 'Page',
packages/plugin-view/src/ViewSwitcher.tsx:92   const DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS: Record<ViewType, LucideIcon> = {  … :104  page: LayoutTemplate,
packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1314   const iconMap: Record<ViewType, string> = {                 … :1326 page: 'layout-template',
```

⭐ Control in the same command: `grid:` rows fire in both files (`ObjectView.tsx` 1, `ViewSwitcher.tsx` 2) ⇒ the instrument reads the tables, and the three `page:` rows are a real subset.

Measured **red on the main-built leg** by the objectui#9880 dev, using objectui#9860's own injection mechanism against objectstack `07c6f822`.

## ⚠️ Why this is NOT the objectui#9880 edit repeated three times

objectui#9880's tables partition the **drawable half** — it repaired them by deriving the undrawable half (`satisfies` + `Extract`) so a retired member becomes inert at type level while staying live at runtime for the resolved spec. ⛔ These three are total over the **whole** `ViewType`, so the same shape does not transfer: they want `satisfies Record<string, X>` **plus a separate totality assert** (`Exclude<ViewType, keyof typeof X> extends never`), or the compiler stops catching an ADDED member — which is the guard objectui#8127 installed and ⛔ nothing here may drop.

## ⚠️ The cascade, so nobody counts it twice

`@object-ui/plugin-view#build` fails on the main leg, and `app-shell` + `example-byo-backend-console` then report 5 × TS7016 「could not find a declaration file」 plus 1 × TS7006. ⇒ those **6 are CASCADE**, ⛔ not independent defects, and they disappear when these three rows are repaired.

## Dedupe words

`plugin-view ViewSwitcher DEFAULT_VIEW_ICONS page` · `Record ViewType page TS2353 plugin-view` · `ObjectView iconMap page retired` · `total over whole ViewType page row` · `spec main leg excess property page`
